title: Many Body in General Relativity: A Thermal Equivalence Principle
content:
We review the physics of many bodies in the context of general relativity.
Starting from the stress energy tensor for one body, for a swarm of bodies,
for a perfect fluid, we review relativistic hydrodynamics, kinetic theory, 
and statistical physics of $N$ identical bodies. We conclude our excursion 
with a {\sl thermal equivalence principle} in physics.
